attempts.text:
The prognosis following radical prostatectomy is influenced by several documented factors. The surgical findings included a Gleason 4+3 (ISUP grade group 3), negative surgical margins, and no seminal vesicle invasion. However, the presence of lymph node metastasis is a significant adverse finding. Preoperative PSA was 3.3. The biopsy-to-prostatectomy difference is noted as the Gleason pattern and ISUP report are missing. Missing nodal sampling, although the record states nodes were sampled, widens uncertainty regarding true nodal status.

The primary driver for risk is the documented lymph node metastasis. Countervailing factors include negative surgical margins and no seminal vesicle invasion. The postoperative PSA trajectory and subsequent follow-up are critical missing pieces of information that would substantially revise this prognosis. The current heuristic horizon suggests a follow-up period of approximately 39 months.

nodal_contradiction: Missing nodal sampling, although the record states nodes were sampled, widens uncertainty regarding true nodal status

attempts.text:
The patient underwent robot-assisted radical prostatectomy with a pathological stage pT2, negative surgical margins, and no seminal vesicle invasion. However, lymph node metastasis was present, and lymphovascular invasion was noted. Preoperative PSA was 3.3. The surgical findings, including the presence of lymph node metastasis, are significant factors driving prognosis. The biopsy-to-prostatectomy difference is noted as the Gleason pattern and ISUP report are missing. The nodal status is documented as positive metastasis.

Countervailing factors include negative surgical margins and no seminal vesicle invasion. The preoperative PSA of 3.3 is a baseline measure. Missing nodal sampling, although the record states nodes were sampled, widens uncertainty regarding true nodal status. The prognosis is informed by the documented presence of lymph node metastasis. Information that would revise the prognosis, especially postoperative PSA and its subsequent trajectory, would include postoperative PSA measurements and follow-up data.

nodal_contradiction: Missing nodal sampling, although the record states nodes were sampled, widens uncertainty regarding true nodal status
